findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The ice machine baffle was observed to have soil accumulation. The operator was informed and instructed to clean the baffle and maintain it free of soil buildup. Ensure the ice machine baffle is cleaned and sanitized to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: The food items in the double doors stainless steel cooler adjacent to the triple sink in the kitchen were observed at a higher temperature than 50F. The volunteers in the kitchen said that they had just moved the items to that cooler a little while ago. The items were removed and placed in the four compartment cooler in the serving area. Ensure that food items in a cold holding unit are held within the range of 41F and below at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: The double doors stainless steel cooler in the kitchen was observed not keeping the appropriate temperature. PIC assured inspector that the cooler will be repair in due time. No food items will be store with in the unit until the necessary repairs are done.  All the hanging thermometers within the unit measured at 51, 55, and 54. The laser thermometer read at 57 for ambient temperature. Ensure the cooler is repaired to enable it to capacitate the adequate temperature range.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: A bucket was observed in the basin of the handwashing sink at the kitchen, causing obstruction for handwashing. CORRECTED - The inspector informed the operator; the bucket was removed and the handwashing sink was made accessible. Ensure handwashing sinks are not obstructed and remain accessible at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [PF]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The ice machine baffle was observed to have soil accumulation. The operator was informed and instructed to clean the baffle and maintain it free of soil buildup. Ensure the ice machine baffle is cleaned and sanitized to sight and touch. The inspector will follow up on May 4, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Single-use Styrofoam plates were observed stored uncovered and not inverted, creating potential exposure to dust and other contamination. CORRECTED - The inspector instructed the operator to invert the plates when not in active use, and the plates were properly inverted. Ensure single-use items are stored inverted and protected from contamination at all times.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(C) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (C) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored as specified under (A) of this section and shall be kept in the original protective PACKAGE or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. The hood baffles on the right side were observed to have significant grease accumulation.
2. The fan covers in the walk-in cooler was observed to have dust accumulation.

The inspector instructed the operator to clean the above-mentioned surfaces to sight and touch. Ensure all nonfood-contact surfaces are routinely cleaned and maintained free of grease and dust accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the floor behind the ice machine to be in disrepair. Parts of the floor have been cut out to accommodate drain for ice machine and walk-in cooler. Discussed with PIC. Ensure the floor is repaired to cover all space not necessary for the piping. Once floor is in place, seal seams around the pipes with silicone.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the drop guard of the main ice machine to be soiled with mold. Ice is being removed and the drop guard is being cleaned and sanitized at the time of inspection. The violation is considered corrected on site. Ensure that the drop guard is maintained clean. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the ice machine drop guard to be soiled with mold. Ensure that the drop guard is maintained free of accumulated soil. 
4-602.11: (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Inspector observed foods requiring refrigeration to be stored in the bar reach in cooler with a temperature of 55F. Two partial bottles of bloody mary mix, an eighth of a bottle of Simply orange, approximately half of a bottle of simply lemon, a portion of olives, cherries, and jalapeños were all voluntarily discarded out of an abundance of caution. Containers read refrigerate after opening and keep refrigerated. 
The glass front cooler next to the reach in is cold and has room to hold the tray of drink garnishes, Freshly open bloody mary mix and other items like the simply juice that require refrigeration. Post reach in cooler to be used for unopened items only.
Continue to use the cold cooler for garnishes or open food that requires refrigeration. TCS foods are foods that require temperature control for safety. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed bottles of chemical cleaners stored on the counter with napkins and straws. Bottles of cleaners were moved down onto the floor next to the other cleaners. Store cleaners and other toxic items properly separated from food related items. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-603.16: Washed EQUIPMENT shall be rinsed so abrasives and chemicals are removed by one of following methods: (A) Using separate water rinse step before SANITIZING in a 3-comp sink or alternative manual method. 

The three part sink was set up as wash, sanitize, rinse. The guide for bartenders at the bar states to set the sink up as wash, rinse, sanitize. The sinks were drained and set up properly with 200ppm of quat sanitizer in the 3rd part.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Observed the fluorescent lighting in the kitchen area to have a large layer of dust. Clean the lighting. It is above food preparation areas. Discussed with PIC. Ensure lighting is cleaned before next routine inspection. Ensure routine cleaning of non-food contact areas.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

Observed hand sink at the bar to have ice dumped within the sink. Observed the kitchen hand sink to be blocked by a rolling cart. Ensure all hand sinks are accessible at all times for employees to wash hands. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed interior baffle of the ice machine in the bar area nearest the kitchen to have mold. Discussed routine cleaning of food-contact surfaces with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 11/15/21.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Ice machine (food contact surface) is soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

Observed ice machine near front bar to have a small accumulation of mold and debris. PIC stated ice machine is regularly professionally cleaned. PIC called and made an appointment for cleaning during inspection. COS.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.citation_text: 3-101.11  (P) A plastic container in the reach in cooler in the kitchen is observed full of mold. The original food in the container is not observable. The container was discarded during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment: PA 100-0367 No certifications for an ANSI accredited allergen course are observable during the inspection. The PIC is instructed to have all certified food protection managers complete and ANSI accredited allergen awareness course and to have the certifications available by the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11  (P) Observed employee foods stored above facility food within the dry storage cooler. Store facility foods separate, away, and/above from personal foods. Discussed during inspection. Reference 3-302.11.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text: 6-501.112  (C) Observed dead bugs and old mouse droppings in the dry storage room. Bacon's Pest Control was present during the inspection. See that facility rooms are cleaned frequently and sufficiently to maintain clean. Reference 6-501.112.
